description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean
